info.title: Webhooks
info.description:
Every topic Whatnot can deliver to your webhook endpoint. Each topic's page shows the headers and payload of its deliveries.

To subscribe to topics and verify deliveries, see the [Webhooks guide](/getting-started/webhooks).

post.description: An order was placed, or for an offer, the seller accepted it. Requires read:orders.

parameters.description: Unique ID of the event. Retries of a delivery send the same ID, so use it to deduplicate.
parameters.name: webhook-id

parameters.description: When this delivery attempt was sent, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Each retry sends a new timestamp.
parameters.name: webhook-timestamp

parameters.description: Space-separated signatures, each `v1,` followed by the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of `{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{body}`, keyed with your webhook secret.
parameters.name: webhook-signature

default.description: Fail delivery. Non-2XX statuses and timeouts are retried.

post.description: Items left a shipment, when it was split or unbundled. shipment_item_ids lists the items still on the shipment after the change, not the removed ones. The body also carries the shipment's parcel, which changes with its items. A shipment the seller bundled into another one loses all its items and is reported by shipments.replaced instead. Requires read:shipments.

id.title: Id
id.description: An existing dimension profile id to reference.

name.title: Name
name.description: The dimension profile's name. When auto-creating a profile this is used as a name prefix, with the weight and dimensions appended.

ownership.description: Whether the dimension profile belongs to the seller or Whatnot.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the dimension profile is active.

DimensionProfile.title: DimensionProfile
DimensionProfile.description:
A dimension profile, also embedded in products and shipment items.

On read, the resolved profile. On create, reference an existing profile by
`id`, or supply `weight` and `dimensions` (with an optional `name`) to
auto-create one.

type.title: Type
type.description: A fixed amount off the order.

url.title: Url
url.description: On create, the image URL to ingest. On read, the CDN URL of the ingested image.

alt.title: Alt
alt.description: The image's alt text / label, if set.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Decimal amount in major currency units, e.g. 42.00.

url.title: Url
url.description: The url of the order in the seller's dashboard.

status.description: The order's status. `pending` orders aren't ready to fulfill; fulfill `pending_fulfillment` orders.

show_id.title: Show Id
show_id.description: The show the order was placed in; null for orders placed anywhere else.

transaction_type.description: How the order was sold, if recorded. `other` covers retired formats.

buyer.description: The Whatnot user who placed the order; requires read:customers.

cancelled_at.title: Cancelled At
cancelled_at.description: When the order was cancelled, if it was.

subtotal.description: The price of the items ordered.

applied_discount.title: Applied Discount
applied_discount.description: The discount from the seller's coupon; null when none applied or the coupon isn't the seller's.

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: The seller-provided external identifier for the product.

url.title: Url
url.description: The url of the product in the seller's inventory dashboard.

options.title: Options
options.description: The product's option axes (e.g. Color, Size).

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the product was last updated.

Product.title: Product
Product.description:
The full representation of a product, shared by the REST v2 `get_product`
response and any full-body product webhooks.

name.title: Name
name.description: The product attribute's display name, if the definition is known.

value.title: Value
value.description: The attribute's value for this product.

url.title: Url
url.description: The url of the shipment in the seller's dashboard.

status.description: The current fulfillment status of this shipment.

fulfillment_method.description: The method of fulfillment for this shipment.

recipient.description: The Whatnot user receiving this shipment; requires read:customers.

weight.description: Package weight, if known and valid.

dimensions.description: Package dimensions, if known and valid.

hazardous_material.description: The hazardous-material classification of this shipment's contents.

documents.description: The shipping documents available for this shipment; requires read:customers.

seller_paid_shipping_cost.description: The seller's share of shipping across this shipment's active orders, set at checkout by the seller's shipping settings. Not the label's purchase price, and excludes later carrier adjustments. Null when none was recorded.

dropoff_due.title: Dropoff Due
dropoff_due.description: Due date at seller-local midnight, serialized with timezone; not the overdue cutoff. Null for pickup, non-pre-transit shipments, or missing inputs.

ship_after.title: Ship After
ship_after.description: Earliest time to ship a shipment held for a weekly bundle or presale; null otherwise. Shipping earlier closes the bundle, so the buyer's later orders go into a new shipment.

replacement_shipment_id.title: Replacement Shipment Id
replacement_shipment_id.description: ID of the shipment that received this shipment's items when it was replaced, including when it was bundled into another shipment, or that items were split off to. The immediate successor, not the final one in a chain.

label_url.title: Label Url
label_url.description: Shipping label URL, if available. Usually hosted by the label provider, which sets how long it stays valid.

bundled_url.title: Bundled Url
bundled_url.description: Combined label and packing slip, or pickup slip URL. This presigned URL is valid for up to 1 hour; re-fetch the shipment with `GET /shipments/{shipment_id}` for a fresh link.

commercial_invoice_url.title: Commercial Invoice Url
commercial_invoice_url.description: Commercial invoice URL from the label provider, if one was issued.

service.title: Service
service.description: The carrier service used for this shipment.

tracking_code.title: Tracking Code
tracking_code.description: The carrier's tracking code for this shipment.

last_mile_tracking_code.title: Last Mile Tracking Code
last_mile_tracking_code.description: The tracking code used for the final leg of delivery.

url.title: Url
url.description: The url of the show in the seller's dashboard.

status.description: The show's lifecycle status. A stopped show can resume; an ended show cannot.

visibility.description: Whether the show is visible to everyone or only to invited viewers.

scheduled_start_at.title: Scheduled Start At
scheduled_start_at.description: When the show is scheduled to start. Not updated when the show goes live.

ended_at.title: Ended At
ended_at.description: When the show ended, if it has.

thumbnail.description: The show's thumbnail image, if set.

example.description: Vintage and modern breaks, giveaways every 30 minutes.
example.title: Sunday Night Pokémon Breaks

WeightUnit.title: WeightUnit
WeightUnit.description: The unit used to express weight.

timestamp.description: When the event happened, in ISO 8601. Stable across retries; the `webhook-timestamp` header is when each attempt was sent.

data.description: The event's data. Its shape depends on the topic.

seller_id.description: The ID of the seller the event belongs to.
